messages:
alice-rd: OK team — US->EU handoff in ~45m. Freeze window starts 00:00 UTC. Posting a tight last-mile checklist so we have one place to coordinate.
deploy-bot: Scheduled change window locked by @alice-rd (window id cw-2026-03-20-01) :lock: Changes with exemption must be tagged.
ben-eng-platform: Can we pin canary to `service-api v3.4.0-canary2`? Metrics looked stable for the last hour on stage.
carla-sre: +1 to pin. I'll run smoke and traces after deployment. @dave-oncall are you good to monitor?
dave-oncall: I'm on for the window. Watchlist: 1) 5% error rate rollback threshold, 2) p50 target < 500ms, p95 target < 1200ms. If either violates for 5 continuous minutes -> rollback.
alice-rd: Pin request in flight. /pin service-api v3.4.0-canary2 (manual approval by alice-rd)
deploy-bot: Command received: `/pin service-api v3.4.0-canary2`
```
result: pinned service-api -> v3.4.0-canary2
canary-id: canary-8792
instances: 3 desired
```
ben-eng-platform: Launching canary rollout now: `kubectl set image deploy/service-api service-api=registry/redwood/service-api:v3.4.0-canary2` then `kubectl rollout status deploy/service-api`
carla-sre: Smoke script (quick):
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood-inference.internal/health | jq .status
curl -sS https://api.redwood-inference.internal/llm/health | jq .ok
# run small inference to ensure cache + kv works
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq .id
```
deploy-bot: Canary rollout in progress: canary-8792 | 1/3 -> 2/3 -> 3/3 (gradual) :rocket:
carla-sre: Canary deployed. Running smoke now.
dave-oncall: Observability note: slight CPU bump on canary pods, p95 +12% but p50 stable. Watching traces for tail latency.
erin-product: Any user-facing feature flips in this rollout? Need to update release notes if yes.
alice-rd: No feature flags in this rollout — config-only optimizations. Release notes: performance and bugfix bullets. @frank-docs heads up to prep notes.
frank-docs: Ack, drafting release-notes entry now. Will include rollback criteria and quiet-window note.
carla-sre: Smoke results: health OK, inference test passed, sample latency within expected. No obvious errors in logs.
ben-eng-platform: Canary metrics (5m aggregate): errors 0.7%, p50 320ms, p95 860ms. Within thresholds.
dave-oncall: Keeping canary for observation. If errors spike >2% sustained for 5m, we trigger immediate rollback to `v3.3.8`. Rolling forward plan: 20m stable -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 10m soak between steps.
alice-rd: Noted. Locking freeze exemptions: embedding config tweak allowed under EX-839, all other changes blocked.
deploy-bot: Canary canary-8792 marked PASS -> proceeding to step rollout (30%). /rollout canary-8792 step=30
```
rollout-id: rollout-4401
status: in_progress
```
ben-eng-platform: Kicking step to 30% now. `kubectl scale --replicas=...` (ops done)
carla-sre: Running quick sanity after 30%: 
`curl .../health` all OK. No spike in error logs.
dave-oncall: After 20m observe: errors 0.9%, p95 880ms. Still healthy. Proceeding to 60% in 5m unless anyone objects.
erin-product: No objections from PM side. Go ahead.
alice-rd: Proceed to 60% in 2m. Tagging shiproom: :bell:
frank-docs: Updating release notes: adding note about quiet window and pin id canary-8792, rollback thresholds, and contact list (alice, ben, carla, dave).
ben-eng-platform: 60% -> 100% plan in place. Will monitor anomaly alerts.
carla-sre: Small alert: transient DB connection error on one host, auto-reconnect resolved. Not seeing user impact. Logging it in incident tracker.
dave-oncall: Agreed to continue. If we see error rate >2% sustained for 5m or p50 > 1500ms, rollback to v3.3.8 immediately.
alice-rd: Final check: any last blockers for full rollout?
erin-product: None. Notify support that it's going live (quiet window started).
frank-docs: Final release notes draft pushed to /docs/releases/v3.4.0.md — include quiet-window and exemption EX-839.
ben-eng-platform: Rolling to 100% now. `kubectl rollout restart deploy/service-api` and scaling updated.
deploy-bot: Rollout update: rollout-4401 -> status: completed -> 100% stable :white_check_mark:
carla-sre: Final smoke OK. No elevated errors.
dave-oncall: Closing monitor window. Will keep an eye for the rest of the quiet period.
alice-rd: Great job everyone. Freeze window active. If any emergencies, use #incidents and calllist. Closing thread and adding a short postmortem note if anything pops in the next 24h. :tada:
